title: Balance transfers under load
explanation: ledger.transfer() reads both balances, awaits the fraud check, then writes balances computed from those stale reads. Concurrent transfers touching the same account interleave across the await, so one write overwrites another: updates are lost and money is created or destroyed.
expected_fix: Make the read, the funds check and the write one atomic step: hold a lock (or use a database transaction) around them, and re-read the balances inside it.
grill_expected_points: The balances are read before the await and written after it, so the write uses stale values (a lost update).
Other requests change the same accounts during the fraud-check await, and their updates get overwritten.
Make the read, the check and the write atomic, with a lock or a database transaction.
chaos_invariant: the sum of all balances stays 1,000,000
